baseline.source: P1 BFP8/HiFi2 fixed108 completion, clean serial evidence

candidate_uncertainty.low: P1 wall as optimistic floor; assumes no net slowdown despite adding BFP8 down and retaining BF16 HiFi4 head
candidate_uncertainty.central: 1.7x P1 as planning allowance for changed precision, output-length variance, and host/prefill uncertainty
candidate_uncertainty.high: 3.2x P1 broad tail allowance; not a measured upper confidence bound
candidate_uncertainty.p2_use: P2 wall is excluded from forecast calibration because an unintended HF CPU process overlapped it; P2 is predecessor/correctness evidence only, not speed ranking.

forecast.method: Scale the exact clean P1 fixed108 measured elapsed. Broad multipliers are planning judgments, not measured precision scaling. Include one model load and one serial fixed108 panel; no selected-policy/rate claim. Reforecast after P2 terminal and root reconciliation before any admission.

hf_followup.reason: Not required as a prerequisite to the P3 full-prompt precision diagnostic: P3 itself includes original full-prompt SK seed42 at cap1024. The SK secondary-HF controls and suffix2048 extension remain required follow-up diagnostics after P3; this decision does not waive or declare them complete.
